Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty indicating little evidence of sustained recovery, says Sudeep Shah; outlines BSE, Groww strategy amid CAS
Markets.summary: The Nifty faces continued bearish pressure after its fourth weekly decline, with crucial support between 23,750 and 23,700 and resistance at 24,150 to 24,200. Meanwhile, Bank Nifty remains range-bound, and stocks like BSE, Groww, and Angel One await decisive breakouts for market direction.

Markets.title: Motilal Oswal AMC CEO Prateek Agrawal explains why he is avoiding large banks, IT and FMCG stocks
Markets.summary: Motilal Oswal AMC is focusing its investments on high-growth sectors such as defence, renewables, hospitals, and digital businesses. At the same time, the asset management company is limiting its exposure to large banks, IT, commodities, FMCG, and traditional vehicles.

Markets.title: Karamtara Engineering IPO: Check opening dates, GMP, price band and other details
Markets.summary: Karamtara Engineering has announced a Rs 875 crore initial public offering with a price band of Rs 241 to Rs 254 per share. The subscription period for the renewable energy and transmission products maker is scheduled to open on September 9.

Markets.title: GQG sale of Adani Energy shares said to disrupt hedge fund bets
Markets.summary: GQG Partners sold shares in Adani Energy Solutions during an MSCI rebalancing auction, flooding the market with unexpected supply and causing a 10% stock drop. This unexpected sell-off overwhelmed passive-fund demand and disrupted hedge funds that had bet on index-driven buying.

Markets.title: NSE IPO gets Sebi approval: 10 important points investors should know as D-Street debut inches closer
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange received regulatory approval from SEBI for its approximately Rs 30,000-crore initial public offering. The proposed share sale involves an offer for sale of roughly a 6% stake and is expected to list on the BSE.

Markets.title: How the rise of institutional investors is changing the IPO playbook
Markets.summary: India's IPO market is shifting as mutual funds, insurers, and global institutions drive deeper participation. This growing institutional selectivity requires sharper price discovery, better market segmentation, and a potential micro-cap category.

Geo-Political.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
Geo-Political.summary: A mistrial was declared in the Lindsay Clancy murder case after the jury deadlocked. It remains uncertain whether she will face criminal liability for the deaths of her three children.

Geo-Political.title: Trump's peace envoys to visit Moscow and Kyiv over weekend
Geo-Political.summary: President Donald Trump's peace envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, are visiting Moscow and Kyiv over the weekend. The envoys are attempting to restart stalled negotiations to end the Russia-Ukraine war.

Geo-Political.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
Geo-Political.summary: Germany has blamed Russia for a recent sabotage attack on Leipzig airport amid a wider wave of suspicious incidents across Europe. Investigators consider Russia the chief suspect in this escalating campaign of continental sabotage.

Geo-Political.title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
Geo-Political.summary: The United Nations voted 164 to one to adopt a new world map that accurately reflects the true size of Africa. The United States was the only nation to vote against the Togo-sponsored resolution.

Geo-Political.title: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
Geo-Political.summary: At least two people died in an explosion at a military barracks in Viacha, Bolivia. Authorities warn the death toll may rise and have advised people to stay away due to the risk of further blasts.

Geo-Political.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
Geo-Political.summary: Germany's far-right AfD party is attempting to win an outright majority in the state election of Saxony-Anhalt. A victory would give the party its first state-level power in Germany since World War Two.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without using paid advertising. This experiment demonstrated that appearing in AI-generated answers is becoming a new source of organic traffic alongside traditional SEO.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: GDP growth resilience, factory slowdown, GST streak
Data & Insights.summary: Mint's weekly data compilation features charts illustrating resilient GDP growth, a factory slowdown, and a steady GST revenue streak. These insights help readers analyze the major economic stories reported throughout the past week.

Data & Insights.title: 'Lower interest rates or...,' Trump turns up heat on hand-picked Fed chair Kevin Warsh, threatens trade shutdown
Data & Insights.summary: President Trump pressured Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh to lower interest rates. Additionally, Trump threatened to cut trade with countries that maintain trade deficits with the United States.

Data & Insights.title: World's biggest wealth fund plans to cut government bonds, US Treasuries face $75 billion impact
Data & Insights.summary: Norway's $2.3 trillion sovereign wealth fund plans to reduce its government bond holdings from 70% to 50% to diversify risk and increase returns. Pending government approval, this shift could result in a $75 billion drop in its US Treasury holdings.

Data & Insights.title: India forex reserves jump $11.5 billion to record high of $740.8 billion
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves increased by $11.5 billion to reach a record high of $740.8 billion. This surpasses the previous peak of $728.494 billion set during the week ending February 27.

Data & Insights.title: E-way bill generation rises 7.7% to over 139 million in August
Data & Insights.summary: E-way bill generation increased by 7.7% to exceed 139 million in August. This marked the fifth consecutive month this fiscal year that volume remained above 130 million.

Data & Insights.title: iBRICS 2026: $1 trillion global sovereign capital in focus as 500 investors gather in Delhi next week
Data & Insights.summary: Next week, the Sovereign Wealth Fund Institute will host the iBRICS 2026 summit in Delhi, gathering 500 investors to focus on $1 trillion in global sovereign capital. The event aims to connect this capital with infrastructure, energy, and digital projects across 21 BRICS member states and partner nations.

India.title: Drunk Man Kills Wife. She Had Refused To Cook To Attend Dance Class
India.summary: In Mumbai, 41-year-old Krishna Lal Yadav killed his wife, Yamini Krishna Lal Yadav, after she refused to cook dinner to attend a dance class. The intoxicated attacker was arrested, leaving behind their two young children.

India.title: NDTV's Global Impact: UN Declares November 27 Day Against Child Marriage
India.summary: The United Nations has declared November 27 as the Day Against Child Marriage due to an ongoing campaign by NDTV and Just Rights for Children. The two organizations have been jointly running the Child Marriage Free India campaign since 2023.

India.title: UPTET 2026 Result: Submit Objections Via Email Till September 10, Check Details
India.summary: Candidates can submit objections to the UPTET 2026 results exclusively by email. The deadline for submitting these objections is September 10.

India.title: Case Against Uttarakhand BJP Members Over M Kharge Rally 'Purification' Row
India.summary: Uttarakhand police registered a zero FIR against several BJP members following a controversy over the "purification" of a rally site used by Congress leader M. Kharge. A zero FIR allows the case to be officially filed at any police station regardless of where the incident occurred.

India.title: Maharashtra Man Honeytrapped For 17 Lakhs. Case Against 7, Including Cop
India.summary: Seven people, including a police officer, blackmailed a Thane man for Rs 17.65 lakh using a compromising video. A criminal case has been registered against the accused individuals.

India.title: "Very Distressing To See...": Top Court Judge Slams Police Crackdown At Jantar Mantar
India.summary: Supreme Court Justice Bhuyan criticized the police crackdown at Jantar Mantar. He stated that the lack of detachment among police officers is a matter of grave concern.

General.title: Cleveland police chief proud of force but being 'let down' by funding
General.summary: Cleveland police chief Victoria Fuller stated that her force is being let down by inadequate funding and needs a resource rethink. Her comments follow an A66 crash in Middlesbrough that resulted in seven deaths, including two police officers.

General.title: 'I'd rather die than ring the police': Distrust and fear in Middlesbrough after A66 crash
General.summary: Violence has escalated in Middlesbrough following a fatal A66 crash. Local residents report living in fear, with some stating they distrust the police too much to report crimes.

General.title: Reform promises to increase tax-free personal allowance to £15,000
General.summary: The party says the tax cut will be paid for by reducing public spending by £80bn.

General.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial has divided US on whether she's victim or criminal
General.summary: The murder trial of Lindsay Clancy has divided the public over whether she is a criminal or a victim of severe mental health struggles. While many argue that her postpartum mental illness does not excuse the murders, others believe the case highlights the critical lack of support for mothers.

General.title: Trump's response is key as Argentina's Falklands demands get louder
General.summary: Argentine President Milei is renewing demands for control over the Falkland Islands. Donald Trump's potential change in stance on British rule will be a crucial factor in the dispute.

General.title: Flight price rises due to 'foolish leaders' starting wars, Virgin's Branson says
General.summary: Middle East tensions have disrupted oil production and transportation, causing a surge in fuel prices. Virgin founder Richard Branson attributes the resulting rise in flight prices to leaders starting wars.
